about: The captain's thoughts on prices that climb (game/prices.py): each one holds for a band of what the captain has bought, so it comes and goes. The sellers' own remarks are in game/prices.py.

thought.price.pod.text: Everything costs more than it did before the pod. I slept through a century of inflation. Technically, the most expensive nap in history.

thought.price.implants.text: Every implant makes the next one dearer. I am getting more expensive to improve, which I choose to take as a compliment.

thought.price.gear.text: The outfitter charges more for every piece I already carry. Armed to the teeth, charged to the eyeballs.

thought.price.lessons.text: The masters charge more the more I know. Knowledge is power, and power is metered.

thought.price.modules.text: Each module on the grips costs more than the last. The yard master says it's the load on the spine. It's the load on my purse he's measuring.

thought.price.upgrades.text: The yard charges the square of the work. A square deal, they call it. A round number would be cheaper.

thought.price.rich.text: I have more money than I had in my whole first century, and the price boards know it. Wealth is relative. So is the yard master, apparently: everything he quotes is related to my balance.
